types.label: Housing Costs
types.definition: Help with rent, eviction-related housing costs or rental deposits; individual program rules and available funds differ.

types.label: Housing Navigation
types.definition: Individual housing assessment, coordinated entry or practical help accessing housing programs; not a guarantee of placement.

types.label: Emergency Shelter
types.definition: Short-term emergency shelter or a named shelter admission pathway.

types.label: Affordable Housing
types.definition: Below-market rental housing with program-specific income and availability rules.

types.label: Housing Vouchers
types.definition: Rental subsidy or housing voucher application and administration.

types.label: Recovery Housing
types.definition: Recovery-oriented sober housing; distinguish from licensed residential clinical treatment.

types.label: Treatment Housing
types.definition: Residential housing available as part of a clinical treatment program with admission and payer requirements.

types.label: Transitional Housing
types.definition: Time-limited housing with a transition or stabilization program.

types.label: Supportive Housing
types.definition: Housing combined with ongoing case management or support services.

types.label: Supported Community Living
types.definition: Disability or older-adult community living arrangements and support; not general affordable rental housing.

types.label: Rapid Rehousing
types.definition: Time-limited assistance to move from homelessness into housing with stabilization support.

types.label: Housing Legal Help
types.definition: Legal advice, negotiation or representation for housing or eviction problems; referral and representation limits vary.

types.label: Prepared Meals
types.definition: Meals ready to eat through community, institutional or program-specific access.

types.label: Food Benefits and Applications
types.definition: Food purchasing/nutrition benefits or practical assistance applying for those benefits.

types.label: Infant Formula
types.definition: An explicitly documented route to infant formula; not inferred from general food boxes.

types.label: Food Pantry
types.definition: Groceries or food boxes through a pantry or distribution, with any boundaries and access limits in the resource.

types.label: Food Delivery
types.definition: Food delivered to a person who cannot reach ordinary meal or pantry access.

types.label: School Food
types.definition: Food or meals accessed through school, campus or student-specific programs.

types.label: Medical Rides
types.definition: Transportation to eligible health appointments; payer and medical-purpose restrictions vary.

types.label: Fares and Passes
types.definition: Bus passes, reduced fares or ride vouchers; mode, eligibility and available funding remain in the service details.

types.label: Program Transportation
types.definition: Transportation restricted to participants of another named service or residential program.

types.label: Volunteer Rides
types.definition: Volunteer-arranged trips with advance booking, geography and driver-capacity limits.

types.label: Travel Training
types.definition: Instruction and practical support learning to use transportation independently.

types.label: Bicycles
types.definition: Provision or repair of bicycles for personal transportation.

types.label: ADA Paratransit
types.definition: Accessible paratransit requiring its specific eligibility assessment and reservation process.

types.label: Commuter Programs
types.definition: Shared or organized commuting options distinct from medical and crisis rides.

types.label: Immigration Documents
types.definition: Replacement or correction of immigration-related identity/status documents, or qualified legal help obtaining them.

types.label: Document Assistance
types.definition: Practical individual help obtaining identity documents or navigating issuing agencies.

types.label: State ID or License
types.definition: Application, replacement or specifically documented assistance obtaining state identification or a driver license.

types.label: Birth Certificates
types.definition: Issuance or specifically documented assistance obtaining a birth certificate.

types.label: Document Storage
types.definition: A specifically documented service keeping important documents safe.

types.label: Mail Service
types.definition: A mailing or document-receipt service for people who need a reliable address.

types.label: Social Security Cards
types.definition: Replacement cards or specifically documented assistance with the replacement process.

types.label: Tribal Credentials
types.definition: Tribal identification or enrollment credentials with community-specific eligibility.

types.label: Military Records
types.definition: Obtaining, recording or replacing military service/discharge records.

forGroups.label: Caregivers
forGroups.definition: Support for unpaid caregivers of older adults, people with disabilities or people with substantial health needs. Includes caregiver-specific respite, education or support; ordinary parenting alone does not qualify.

forGroups.label: Domestic violence survivors
forGroups.definition: A dedicated domestic/intimate-partner abuse safety, shelter, advocacy, legal or recovery pathway. Other uses of the word survivor do not qualify.

forGroups.label: Families
forGroups.definition: A service designed for a household, parent-child unit, kinship family or family supporters. A family-law case alone does not establish a family-service program.

forGroups.label: Foster & kinship families
forGroups.definition: A specific foster-care, adoptive-family or relative/kinship-caregiver service or eligibility route. General parenting and a vague child-welfare reference do not automatically qualify.

forGroups.label: Homeless
forGroups.definition: A program specifically addressing homelessness, unsheltered living or imminent housing loss. Poverty, food need or ordinary rental assistance alone does not establish this pathway.

forGroups.label: Immigrants
forGroups.definition: An immigration, refugee, asylee or newcomer-specific eligibility, legal or settlement pathway. Language use alone does not establish immigration status.

forGroups.label: LGBTQ+
forGroups.definition: A dedicated LGBTQ+ program, coordinator or explicitly documented population-specific access pathway. General nondiscrimination alone does not qualify.

forGroups.label: Low-income households
forGroups.definition: An explicit financial-eligibility, means-tested or dedicated low-income assistance pathway. Being free, nonprofit or generally available does not by itself qualify.

forGroups.label: Medically vulnerable
forGroups.definition: A dedicated condition, recovery, medical-equipment or clinically vulnerable access pathway such as cancer rides, NICU support or medical respite. General patients or all Medicaid members do not automatically qualify.

forGroups.label: Men
forGroups.definition: A dedicated men’s program, men’s housing or father-specific pathway. A general service admitting adults does not qualify solely because men may participate.

forGroups.label: Native American
forGroups.definition: A tribal-member-specific or explicitly Native/urban-Indian culturally focused program. Tribal-land benefit geography alone does not establish identity-based eligibility; culturally focused programs may also welcome other clients.

forGroups.label: People with disabilities
forGroups.definition: A disability-targeted program, eligibility route or documented disability accommodation. Diagnosis or participation in health care alone does not qualify. Includes the more specific vision and hearing groups.

forGroups.label: Pet owners
forGroups.definition: A documented pet-accommodation, pet-supply or pet-related access pathway. This does not promise that every animal or shelter placement is accepted.

forGroups.label: Pregnant/postpartum
forGroups.definition: A pregnancy, birth, lactation, postpartum or perinatal-loss pathway. General women’s health alone does not qualify.

forGroups.label: Re-entry
forGroups.definition: A service explicitly targeted to people preparing for release, returning from custody, under justice supervision or addressing a criminal-record barrier. Prior incarceration is not required for every included program.

forGroups.label: Seniors
forGroups.definition: A dedicated older-adult program, age-based benefit or specific older-adult access pathway. A general service available across all ages does not qualify solely because it mentions older adults.

forGroups.label: Spanish
forGroups.definition: Explicit Spanish-language service, interpretation, staff or program access. This describes language access and does not imply ethnicity or immigration status.

forGroups.label: Students
forGroups.definition: A service tied to school or college enrollment, a school partnership or student-specific eligibility. General adult education open to the public does not automatically qualify.

forGroups.label: Uninsured/underinsured
forGroups.definition: Explicit care, fee assistance or enrollment access for people lacking adequate health coverage. Merely accepting insurance does not qualify.

forGroups.label: Veterans
forGroups.definition: A dedicated military-service, veteran or eligible military-household pathway. Service, discharge and program rules differ.

forGroups.label: Women
forGroups.definition: A dedicated women’s program or women-specific health, housing or support pathway. A name or a condition affecting all genders does not establish this group.

forGroups.label: Youth
forGroups.definition: A child, adolescent or explicitly youth-targeted young-adult pathway. Program ages vary; a general adult service is not tagged merely because some young adults could use it.
